summary: A sprawling four-domain run (shopping, airline ×2 customers, customer-support, travel) for several people, opening with a notable misstep: at T1 the agent guesses a default shopping account (Maya Chen) because none was given, and at T2 the user corrects it (‘I'm Evan Parker’) — the agent apologizes and redoes everything properly, the one REFLECT+FIX turn. From there: airline booking D3A184 review + baggage policy + add-a-bag (T3–T5), a new flight booking for Megan Carter paid by certificate+card (T6), a D3A184-vs-Megan comparison with a mouse search (T7), product details + exchange policy (T8), a discount recall + support-scope workaround + exchange preview (T9), the exchange itself (T10), Elena Brooks' hotel policy + cancellation preview (T11), a two-item memory recap (T12), the hotel cancellation + D3A184 restatement (T13), and a summary (T14). The probe turns (T2, T10, T12, T13) are one REFLECT+FIX (T2) and three COMPLY recalls; T12 is explicitly pure recall (‘no need to re-query’). Recall is solid (12/16 credited) and the agent routes around repeated Pydantic/scope failures via direct SQL and scope edits.
